dateAssessment: Working civil dates are YAML’s October 17–18, 1748. The transcript independently establishes mid-October, an opening sunset around 6 p.m., one overnight and roughly 4 a.m. waking (t01–t03). Its full-span assessment remains compatible, with later timing open because the archive break was not recorded. Short narrated advances support an inferred dawn watch through the crypt departure; the archive rest has no established watch or completed duration. The dated Session 2 note supplies context for the omitted library encounter, not additional transcript timing.

watches.summary: Opening sunset is about six in the evening; mid-October is spoken.
Eight-hour rest convention, back-calculated from roughly 4 a.m. waking, puts the overnight start in dusk.
Waking is roughly 4 a.m.; vineyard crossing, hedge cutting and trapdoor clearing add about thirty minutes, plus brief actions.
Archive short rest accepted; the omitted recording leaves its completion, duration and watch unestablished.
